summary: Each rank performs the full CSR product for its floor-partitioned row interval once per requested iteration. Restrict-qualified pointers have not caused the compiler to collapse repetitions.

source_evidence.claim: Local matrix construction includes each owned row and its nonzeros. The timed loop calls the complete local product using the CLI iteration count, independently of optional validation.

compiled_evidence.claim: vmulsd/vaddsd at 9bcc/9bd5 remain inside three nested loops, including outer 9bf7->9b80; the bound executable does not replace repetitions with a single computation.
